summary: Re-verified Pulse /pulse mobile horizontal overflow fix. Mobile (390x800): documentElement.scrollWidth = 390 (was 441 in iteration_3, target <=410) -- PASS. No element extends beyond viewport (right>395 returns []). Subject Completion card width 366px, all 12 rows are 322px wide and contained. Desktop (1920x1080) sanity check: all 12 subject rows render with progress bars in the 2-column grid layout, no regression.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/Pulse.jsx lines 167-177 correctly applied: shrink-0 on icons/labels/values, min-w-0 + truncate on subject name label, w-16 sm:w-24 on progress bar. Row is constrained and uses flex-1 truncate properly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile /pulse overflow regression from iteration_3 is fully resolved (390 scrollWidth on 390 viewport). Desktop layout preserved with all 12 subjects and progress bars visible.
rca of the issue: Root cause from iteration_3: Subject Completion row used fixed widths without shrink-0/min-w-0 constraints, causing total inner width to exceed 390px on mobile. Fix correctly applies shrink-0 to fixed-width children (subject code w-10, count w-12 sm:w-14, percent w-9, progress bar w-16 sm:w-24) and min-w-0 + truncate + flex-1 on the subject name span so it absorbs available space without forcing overflow.
